From the kitchen

Photos from the tavern’s own Google listing.

Andama in Protaras

Andama Tavern sits on Protaras Avenue, a short way from Fig Tree Bay: red and white chequered tablecloths, wooden chairs, colourful shutters and a raised terrace at the front. On Google, guests praise the friendly staff, the generous portions, the kleftiko and the Salmon Madagascar, and several write that they came back more than once during their holiday. Families mention the colouring sheets and crafts for children.

Open every day from 12:30 to 23:00. Book by phone or online.
